saints.name: John Chrysostom
saints.legacy: Master of eloquence and pastoral care
saints.summary: John Chrysostom was a prominent early Church Father known for his eloquent preaching and extensive writings. He served as the Patriarch of Constantinople and was a key figure in the development of Christian liturgy. Despite facing exile and hardship due to his outspoken criticism of vice, he remained steadfast in his faith and is remembered as a Doctor of the Church.
